message:
The other day, we had a little scare with the weather forecast, and just like that, our family group chat came alive. I could almost hear the laughter through the screen as my kids started sharing their go-bag ideas—who needs snacks, who’s bringing the extra socks, and of course, the debate over whose stuffed animal is the most essential. 

It was a gentle reminder that while we plan for the unexpected, it’s the connections and shared moments that really matter. After all, a little preparedness can lead to a lot of love and laughter. 

Have you had a similar chat with your family recently?
